title: NASA didn't want to talk after news called them

tellings.quote: >> Well, from what I heard was just something I mentioned got the attention of the news and the news called NASA and NASA's like, "God, we don't want to talk about this."

plain: Something Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, mentioned in public around 2024 caught the attention of a news outlet, which then called NASA, the US space agency, and NASA's reaction was, in effect, "God, we don't want to talk about this." Bledsoe tells it second-hand, as what he heard from a friend in the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, in Washington. To him it suggests the agency knows of his case but would rather stay quiet.
